scope: Local installed Python stdio-to-HTTP relay repair, tested only against owned loopback fixtures. No real vendor endpoint, Keychain, OAuth refresh or business tools invoked.

coverage: return matching JSON-RPC response before SSE EOF
progress and Boolean request IDs do not complete integer-ID requests
LF/CRLF/CR, BOM, multiline SSE and split UTF-8
incomplete and unrelated streams fail without retry
HTTP error bodies excluded and redirects not followed

limitations: Controlled stream timing, not a live Design API benchmark or business-task acceptance.
Existing relay processes were not restarted; changed source is loaded on next startup.
The relay remains a serial request bridge; continuous server-to-client dispatch and resumption are not added.
No changes to configured endpoint, credential lookup, credential refresh, redirects or login.
No automatic retries added; tool-call failure does not establish that its action was not executed.
Only a local source repair and reviewable patch are delivered; no upstream submission or App release.
